title: Show rocket status hint in completion report after rocket loop ends
description: After a loop session that completes at least one task, append a hint in the completion report suggesting the user run 'rocket status' to see overall progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Hint 'Run rocket status to see overall progress' appears in completion report after a successful session
Hint is NOT shown when the session ends without completing any tasks
Hint uses cyan color for the command name

steps.description: Track whether any task was completed in the session
steps.details: In RocketLoopApp, when the loop emits a 'complete' event, set a completedTask flag. Pass this to CompletionReport.

steps.description: Add hint to CompletionReport when task was completed
steps.details: In CompletionReport.tsx, add prop: taskCompleted: boolean. If true: <Text marginTop={1}>Run <Text color='cyan'>rocket status</Text> to see overall progress.</Text>

steps.description: Verify hint appears and disappears correctly
steps.details: Test: run loop on a task that completes → hint appears. Test: run loop that reaches max-iterations without <complete> → hint does not appear.
